            y0, y1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            x0, x1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            objs.append((color, cells, y0, x0, y1-y0+1, x1-x0+1))

    # objects placed first and the lower-band objects placed beneath them.
    mid = h / 2

    lower.sort(key=lambda o: o[3])
